findings.issue: The App's filter handler passes `data` as the second argument to statisticsView, which is what keeps the G-2 target computed from every stored hand. No test covers this wiring. SPEC-07 is tested only through the test's own `filtered()` helper (trend-filters.acceptance.test.tsx:75), and the e2e seeds only 700 hands, so g2Target is null under every filter.
findings.evidence: Reasoned mutation: change App.tsx:315 to `statisticsView(filterTrendData(data, filter))`. Every unit, acceptance and e2e test would still pass, but G-2 would then come from the filtered hands. This follows the spec (SPEC-07 is specified at module level), so it is not a SPEC violation.
findings.fix: Optional: in a later e2e (or in statistics-filters.spec.ts with ≥1,000 seeded hands), select a filter that leaves points and assert that the target line's y1 or the aria-label suffix equals the All-hands target. Alternatively, move the recompute into a tiny exported function in trends.ts that the App calls and the acceptance test uses.

findings.issue: `if (data === undefined) return;` cannot trigger. The selects render only when view is a loaded StatisticsView, and data is always set together with it. The guard exists only to narrow the optional `data?` type.
findings.evidence: App.tsx:104 sets data and view together. Lines 110 and 261 set view null or undefined, and in both cases StatisticsScreen renders no select (A-2).
findings.fix: Acceptable as is. Alternatively, model the loaded state as `{ view: StatisticsView; data: TrendData }` in a separate union arm so no guard is needed.

findings.issue: screenType() cuts `type Screen` at the first `;` at brace depth 0, including a `;` inside a `//` comment between union members. The builder hit this and reworded the App.tsx comment instead of changing the locked test (correct under the locked-test rule).
findings.evidence: play-money.ts:41-51 counts braces and `;` without skipping comments or strings. The failure is loud: routes after the cut drop out, and the locked `toEqual` on the routes list fails. It cannot pass silently.
findings.fix: No follow-up needed now: it fails safe and has cost one reword. If it trips again, add a small infra task to strip `//` and `/* */` comments before scanning (an unlocked e2e/support helper change).

summary: The implementation matches the spec. filterTrendData buckets every hand of a session by the largest dealtIn through referenceSizeOf, with a 2–10 guard so it never throws. Game type uses the presence of `cash`, and All / All returns the same data object. The App recomputes statisticsView(filtered, data), so G-2 always comes from every stored hand, and BB/100 stays cash-only. The G-2 caption, line and aria suffix stay inside MajorErrorTrend, which renders only for points. Mutation check (bucket per hand instead of per session, run in an isolated worktree): the SPEC-09 unit test fails (session A, 6 then 2 seats, leaks into Heads-up), while the AC#1–AC#8 acceptance tests stay green because their pools have a uniform dealt-in count. That is acceptable, since SPEC-09 owns this rule. The e2e passes in Chromium and WebKit. Lint, typecheck and tests are green per the fix-2 gate. Lines are 648 against a budget of 640 (warn only). No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
